hotel.title: Clear Span Storage Tents
hotel.description: Column-free structures from 3m to 50m+ wide. Deploy on concrete, asphalt, or compacted soil. No interior poles to restrict forklift or vehicle movement.
hotel.detailedBody: Clear span tents are the workhorse of industrial storage in the UAE. The absence of interior columns maximises usable floor area and allows unrestricted movement of forklifts, trucks, and heavy equipment. High-strength 6061-T6 aluminum frames support 850 gsm PVC fabric covers rated to 100+ km/h wind loads. Widths from 3m to 50m+, any length, with eave heights up to 8m+ for high-rack storage systems.

corporate.title: Labor Accommodation Tents
corporate.description: UAE-compliant workforce housing for construction sites and industrial facilities. Air-conditioned, ventilated, and meeting the 3 sqm per worker regulatory standard.
corporate.detailedBody: UAE labor accommodation regulations require minimum 3 sqm per worker, proper ventilation, and air conditioning — our structures meet these standards from day one. Labor tents include integrated electrical distribution, ventilation systems, and Civil Defence-approved fire safety provisions. Used by major contractors across the UAE for construction camps, project workforce housing, and industrial facility support accommodation.

home.title: Warehouse Frame Tents
home.description: Install on any hard surface — concrete, asphalt, rooftops — without ground penetration. Wind-rated to 100+ km/h. Ideal for free zones and developed industrial sites.
home.detailedBody: Warehouse frame tents solve a specific problem: deploying covered storage on fully developed surfaces where ground staking is prohibited. The self-supporting frame system installs via ballast weights or expansion bolts on concrete. Used extensively in UAE free zones, port facilities, and logistics parks. Available with roller shutter doors, skylight panels, fire suppression integration, and climate control.

furniture.detailedBody: The tent is the shell; the furniture is the experience. We hold the largest inventory of event-specific furniture in the region. Every cushion, table, and rug is inspected, cleaned, and maintained to ensure a 5-star experience.

decor.title: Cold Storage Tents
decor.description: Temperature-controlled fabric structures for perishable goods, pharmaceuticals, and cold chain logistics. Operating range -20°C to +55°C ambient.
decor.detailedBody: UAE's extreme ambient temperatures make cold storage infrastructure critical for food distribution, pharmaceutical logistics, and fresh produce supply chains. Our cold storage tents feature insulated sandwich panel systems equivalent to permanent cold rooms, combined with modular refrigeration units. Deployed in weeks at 50–70% lower capital cost than permanent cold rooms. Pharma GDP-compliant configurations available.

iftar.title: Construction Site Storage
iftar.description: Protect AED millions in materials from UAE heat, sand, and rain. On-site storage deployed within your construction footprint — minimising material handling distances.
iftar.detailedBody: Construction material loss from weather exposure is a major cost on UAE sites. Cement, steel reinforcement, electrical components, and finishing materials require protected storage from day one. Our construction site tents deploy within the project footprint, minimise material handling distances, and protect assets from the UAE's extreme heat, sandstorms, and seasonal rainfall.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Industrial Storage Tent Rentals & Solutions in the UAE
faq.intro: At Tent Now, we've spent 30 years answering every technical question about industrial storage structures. We've compiled the most common questions here — with clear expert answers reflecting our deep knowledge of UAE regulations, structural engineering standards, and operational requirements.

when.q: How quickly can you deploy a storage tent in the UAE?
when.a: Standard clear span structures are operational within 3–7 days depending on size. For urgent requirements, we offer 72-hour emergency deployment for pre-engineered configurations. All permit processing runs simultaneously to avoid delays.

howEarly.q: What are the cost savings of a storage tent versus a permanent warehouse?
howEarly.a: Industry data consistently shows 50–70% cost savings on total project costs including construction time, materials, labour, and permitting. With Dubai permanent warehouse rents up 33% in 2024 and construction timelines of 6–18 months, storage tents offer a dramatically faster and more cost-effective solution for most applications.

difference.q: What is the difference between clear span, frame, and industrial tents?
difference.a: Clear span tents have no interior support columns — ideal for forklift operations and maximum usable space, available 3m to 50m+ wide. Frame tents install on any hard surface without ground penetration — ideal for developed sites like free zones and ports. Industrial tents are configured for specialist applications including cold storage, oil & gas, and labor accommodation with specific safety specifications.

permits.q: What permits are required for storage tents in the UAE?
permits.a: Dubai Municipality requires permits under Article 13, with fines up to AED 10,000 for unauthorized structures. Civil Defence approval is required for occupied structures. Abu Dhabi DMT permits apply in the capital. Free zone installations have separate authority approvals. Our team handles all permit applications, structural drawings, and safety certifications at no additional charge.

cooling.q: Can storage tents withstand UAE summer temperatures and sandstorms?
cooling.a: Yes. Our structures use 850 gsm PVC-coated polyester fabric with UV stabilisers rated for 15–20 year service life under UAE conditions. For temperature-sensitive applications, insulated panel systems maintain controlled internal temperatures in 45°C+ summer conditions. Frames are wind-rated to 100+ km/h for sandstorm resistance.

custom.q: Can you build a tent that meets UAE labor accommodation standards?
custom.a: Yes. UAE labor accommodation regulations require minimum 3 sqm per worker, proper ventilation, air conditioning, and fire safety provisions. Our labor accommodation tents are engineered to these standards with integrated HVAC systems, electrical distribution, and Civil Defence-approved fire safety specifications. We handle all regulatory documentation.

moonSighting.question: How is the Ramadan start date confirmed in UAE?
moonSighting.answer: The UAE Moon Sighting Committee, composed of religious scholars and astronomers, meets on the 29th of Sha'ban to sight the crescent moon. If sighted, Ramadan begins the next day. If not, Sha'ban completes 30 days, and Ramadan starts the following day. The official announcement is made after sunset on the sighting day.

workHours.question: What are the work hours during Ramadan in UAE?
workHours.answer: Both public and private sector working hours are reduced during Ramadan. Typically, work hours are shortened by 2 hours per day. Private sector companies often operate from 9 AM to 3 PM, while government offices may have different schedules. This applies to all employees, whether fasting or not.

tourists.question: What should tourists and non-fasting residents know?
tourists.answer: While UAE is tolerant and welcoming, respect for those fasting is expected. Avoid eating, drinking, or smoking in public during fasting hours (sunrise to sunset). Most malls and hotels have designated areas for dining. Dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered), keep music at respectful levels, and note that many restaurants are closed until Iftar time.

booking.question: When should I book Ramadan tent rentals for 2026?
booking.answer: Popular dates and premium setups book 2-3 months in advance. For corporate events, government Iftars, or large family gatherings requiring permits and customization, we recommend booking by December 2025 or early January 2026. Last-minute bookings (February) are possible but have limited availability and options.
